options.content: Start with **Recent traces by service** to find slow or failed work. Narrow with an operation name or privacy-safe span tags such as `error=true`, `domain.operation=email_delivery`, `domain.outcome=failed`, `service.role=email`, or `email.recipient_ref=<ref>`. Open a result for the span waterfall. If a log provides a trace ID, paste it into **Trace ID** and use **Correlated logs** to inspect the same incident window. A missing trace does not prove the request never ran: ordinary successful traces are sampled, while errors and incident operations are retained.

Enter a Trace ID in the **Trace ID (staff only)** variable at the top of this dashboard, then [open the trace in Explore](/explore?schemaVersion=1&orgId=1&panes=%7B%22a%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22victoriatraces%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22datasource%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22jaeger%22%2C%22uid%22%3A%22victoriatraces%22%7D%2C%22query%22%3A%22${trace_id:percentencode}%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22${__from}%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22${__to}%22%7D%7D%7D) for its span waterfall. A trace lookup that runs when the dashboard opens would ask for the placeholder ID and show an error.
